body.message:
Thank you for the information!
I would appreciate some additional details:

• Is the property available immediately?
• What is the monthly rental rate for the short-term option?
• How are payments structured? Is rent paid monthly, every 3 months, or in another way?
• Is there a security deposit? If so, how much is it?
• Are there any additional fees (agency fees, DEWA, internet, service charges, cleaning fees, etc.)?
• Do you have any additional photos or videos of the apartment that are not included in the listing?
• Is it possible for my husband, who is currently in Dubai, to arrange a viewing on my behalf?

We are a family of 3 (with my husband and daughter) so if there are other appartments like this we might be interested too :)
